chunks: From him, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, from Abu 'Abd Allah, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, from the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family.

That a man with a large belly who had committed a forbidden act was brought, so the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, called for a palm stalk bearing one hundred branches, then struck him one single strike, and that constituted the hadd.

key_terms.بِعُرْجُونٍ: with a palm stalk or branch
key_terms.شِمْرَاخٍ: slender branchlets or strands on the stalk
key_terms.مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً: a single time, in one strike

ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله carry out the hadd punishment in the case of a physically large man who committed a forbidden act?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal case in which the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله applied the hadd punishment through a single strike using a palm stalk with one hundred branchlets. It indicates a jurisprudential ruling concerning the implementation of the legal penalty in a form that still fulfilled the prescribed hadd.
